Also we have our B2C online system www.travelyalla.com  that helps our customers around the world to book online hotels, Airline Tickets and car rental we are growing rapidly in the region that we serve Travel yalla tours had a big community in Egypt and Arab region more than millions fans and data base and regular guest always trust in tourism services provided from the company .
